context: A retired official talks to a uni reporter about civic life
purpose: Teach: 増税/喪失/上陸/遺体/寺院/決着/住人/渡り

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本日はお時間をいただきありがとうございます。市民生活について率直なお話を伺えればと思います。
lines.en: Thank you for your time today. I'd like to hear your honest thoughts on civic life.
lines.style: Polite student reporter opening the interview respectfully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うん、構わんよ。最近の若い記者さんは熱心だね。何でも聞きなさい。
lines.en: Sure, I don't mind. Young reporters these days are dedicated. Ask me anything.
lines.style: Warm elderly tone, encouraging and slightly paternal in delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: では早速ですが、来年予定されている増税について、町の住人の方々はどう受け止めているのでしょうか。
lines.en: Right away then, how are the town's residents taking the tax hike planned for next year?
lines.style: Direct journalistic question with formal sentence structure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 正直に言えば、皆、行政への信頼の喪失を感じておる。十分な説明もなく決着をつけられた印象が強くてな。
lines.en: Honestly speaking, everyone feels a loss of trust in the administration. It feels like the matter was settled without enough explanation.
lines.style: Reflective elder speech with archaic verb endings like おる.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。先月、台風が上陸した際の避難所運営でも、行政への不満の声があったと聞きました。
lines.en: I see. I heard there were also complaints toward the administration over the shelter operations when the typhoon hit last month.
lines.style: Probing follow-up referencing recent local events thoughtfully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ああ、あの時は避難所が足りず、近所の寺院の渡り廊下まで毛布を並べてな。お年寄りが何人も体調を崩したよ。
lines.en: Ah, at that time the shelters weren't enough, so we lined blankets all the way down the connecting corridor of the nearby temple. Several elderly folks fell ill.
lines.style: Somber recollection delivered with quiet, weighted gravity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうでしたか…。現場を知る方の言葉は、本当に重く響きます。遺体は出なかったとはいえ、紙一重の状況だったのですね。
lines.en: Was that so... The words of someone who knows the scene really carry weight. Although there were no fatalities, it sounds like it was a very close call.
lines.style: Subdued student reaction acknowledging the severity with care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うむ、紙一重だった。だからこそ、君ら若い世代が声を上げてくれんとな。記事、しっかり書いてくれよ。
lines.en: Indeed, a close call. That's exactly why your younger generation needs to raise their voices. Write a solid article, alright?
lines.style: Encouraging closing remark with gentle generational appeal.
